note: Citation ledger. `file` + `lines` are line ranges in the runnable clone's own tracked source (src/sections/*.jsx, one component per route holding <main>, plus the shared consent component). Generated by extraction/build_source_map.py from src/routes.js order; verify_all.py re-reads every range and requires the cited tag on the first line. The earlier ledger cited rendered-HTML snapshots under recon/, which the package never tracked, so a full git clone could not check a single citation. `dom` tells extraction/measure_sections.mjs which rendered element each entry is. Whole-document sections are decomposed by real content boundaries (`parent` names the block they came from).
